name: DHSP Summer Camps and Programs (K-8)
operator_name: City of Cambridge Department of Human Service Programs (DHSP)
description_short: City-run full-day summer camps (8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.) for Cambridge residents and City employees' children in Kindergarten through 8th grade, including Community Schools Summer Camps, the King Open Extended Day Summer Program, and Cambridge Youth Programs Pre-Teen / Middle School Summer Programs. Places are filled through a single lottery, and tuition is based on family size and income.
refund_policy_summary: A non-refundable tuition deposit is due in June. Other refund terms are not stated. To drop a session, contact DHSP.
special_needs_notes: Children with IEPs or 504 Plans are encouraged to apply, and having one does not affect lottery chances. DHSP's Inclusion Initiative assesses each child and arranges extra supports where needed. Camp Rainbow, a separate program, serves Cambridge residents with disabilities ages 6-22 and provides transportation.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim at Cambridge pools staffed by Red Cross-certified lifeguards. Children in K-5 get swim instruction and learn pool safety. There is also waterplay at playgrounds near the camp sites.

warnings: Old season: this page shows the 2026 summer, which has already ended. It says: 'Information about the 2027 Summer Lottery will be announced in February 2027.' 2027 dates, sessions and tuition are not published yet.
The 2026 Session 1 (June 29 – July 2) was cancelled because of snow days, so it is left out. One FAQ still calls Session 1 'a single week'.

This page covers several programs at several sites under one lottery: Community Schools Summer Camps, the King Open Extended Day Summer Program, and CYP Pre-Teen / Middle School Programs. It is not a single camp.
Only Cambridge residents and City of Cambridge employees can apply. Places are given by lottery, not first come, first served.
Tuition is a sliding scale shown in a separate PDF (DHSP Summer Tuition 2026) that is not included here, so no prices were recorded. CYP is free for 13-year-olds.
